scientific_integrity: The matrix inverse is prior published work and credited. The new result is the joint alarm event identity. Same mathematical model proof review and finite exact checker conducted; independent review not performed. Bibliographic equivalence risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exact population probabilities for a known finite tree with one random epidemic source and independent undirected edge transmissions strictly between zero and one; no sample estimators, nonlinear transmission correlations, cycles, or timing conclusions.
title: A path-local joint-alarm identity for heterogeneous tree epidemics
